title: Setup Next.js, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, and Hono backend structure
body:
### Objective
Initialize full-stack project architecture with Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui component styling, TypeScript, and unified Hono backend server architecture.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Next.js 14+ App Router structure initialized.
- Tailwind CSS and theme tokens configured for dark-mode fintech aesthetic.
- Hono server initialized with modular route structure.
- Monolithic / unified dev scripts configured in package.json.

title: Generate v0.dev style Fintech Dashboard layout (Sidebar, Stat Cards)
body:
### Objective
Craft an elite dark-mode fintech dashboard layout inspired by modern financial SaaS products (Mercury, Ramp, Linear).

### Acceptance Criteria
- Collapsible/responsive sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Transactions, Analytics, Budgets, Settings).
- Header with active workspace, user profile avatar, and theme toggle.
- Metric stat cards: Total Balance, Monthly Inflow, Monthly Outflow, Net Savings Rate, and Anomaly Alert Counter.
- Micro-interactions, subtle borders (`border-border`), and modern glowing accent gradients.

title: Build Transaction Table & Analytics Charts UI
body:
### Objective
Develop interactive transaction table with category pills, status indicators, search/filter, and rich analytical charts using Recharts.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Transaction table supporting date, merchant/description, category badge, amount (+/-), and anomaly flag.
- Cash flow area chart / bar chart comparing income vs expenses over time.
- Expense category breakdown donut chart.
- Quick-action dialog to add new manual transactions.

title: Implement mock-service.ts for finance data
body:
### Objective
Provide comprehensive realistic financial mock data and client service layer for offline development and testing fallback.

### Acceptance Criteria
- `mock-service.ts` created with realistic transaction records, recurring subscriptions, and category aggregates.
- Realistic distributions: Groceries, Utilities, Salary, Investments, Entertainment, Dining, Transport.
- Utility functions to query, filter, and calculate metrics.

title: Define OpenAPI contract (openapi.yml)
body:
### Objective
Formally specify all LedgerAI backend REST APIs using the OpenAPI 3.0 specification.

### Acceptance Criteria
- `openapi.yml` document created.
- Endpoints specified for auth, transactions (CRUD), analytics summary, categories, budgets, and AI anomaly detection.
- Request schemas, response bodies, and error status codes fully defined.

title: Initialize Hono backend & In-Memory storage controllers
body:
### Objective
Build high-performance Hono API server with structured routing, input validation (zod), and in-memory fallback controllers.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Hono app mounted with CORS, logger, and error handling middleware.
- Route controllers for `/api/transactions`, `/api/analytics`, `/api/budgets`, and `/api/ai`.
- In-memory data store supporting full CRUD operations matching OpenAPI contract.

title: Setup Prisma schema with SQLite provider & seed 500 transactions
body:
### Objective
Configure persistent data layer using Prisma ORM with SQLite provider, and generate realistic seed dataset of 500 transactions.

### Acceptance Criteria
- `prisma/schema.prisma` defined with User, Account, Transaction, Category, Budget, and AnomalyAlert models.
- Migration generated and applied to SQLite database (`dev.db`).
- `prisma/seed.ts` implemented generating 500 varied, date-distributed financial transactions.

title: Connect Frontend to Hono Backend API (replace mocks)
body:
### Objective
Wire Next.js frontend client components and hooks directly to the live Hono backend API endpoints.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Replace static mock calls with type-safe fetchers hitting `/api/transactions`, `/api/analytics`, etc.
- Optimistic updates or fast revalidation on creating transactions.
- Graceful fallback and health check integration.

title: Implement AI Categorization & Anomaly Detection API endpoint
body:
### Objective
Implement intelligent rule-based & statistical heuristic engine for auto-categorization and spending anomaly detection.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Endpoint `/api/ai/suggest-category` predicting category from merchant name & description.
- Endpoint `/api/ai/detect-anomalies` flagging transactions with unusual spending deviation (z-score / spending multiplier > 2.5x mean).
- Budget alert triggers when spending exceeds threshold limits.

title: Add loading states, error boundaries, and toast notifications
body:
### Objective
Provide production-grade UX with polished skeleton loaders, graceful error boundary handling, and accessible toast notifications.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Skeleton loader components for stat cards, chart containers, and transaction rows.
- Global React Error Boundary displaying friendly recovery UI.
- Toast notification system triggered on transaction creation, update, deletion, and alerts.

title: Write Hono Integration Tests (Vitest) for API endpoints
body:
### Objective
Implement comprehensive automated integration test suite with Vitest validating Hono API endpoints and business logic.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Vitest configured with TypeScript support.
- Integration tests covering Transaction CRUD, Analytics calculations, AI categorization, and Anomaly detection.
- 100% test pass rate verifying status codes, payload shapes, and boundary conditions.

title: Implement User Authentication (NextAuth credentials slice)
body:
### Objective
Implement robust authentication slice using NextAuth / Auth credentials flow with password hashing and session tokens.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Login and Registration views styled with dark-mode fintech UI.
- Password hashing (bcryptjs/argon2/webcrypto) and session token management.
- Protected API routes and client-side session context.

title: Playwright E2E Test: User Login and Registration Flow (Must use Playwright)
body:
### Objective
Playwright End-to-End Test for user authentication: registration, credentials validation, login redirect, and session persistence.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Playwright test file covering user registration flow.
- Validation of login failure on bad credentials and success on valid credentials.
- Test executes headless and passes in automated CI/CD environment.

title: Playwright E2E Test: Add Income and Expense Transactions (Must use Playwright)
body:
### Objective
Playwright End-to-End Test for creating new income and expense entries via the transaction modal.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Playwright test fills transaction form (amount, category, description, type, date).
- Submits form and verifies new entry appears in the transaction table.
- Confirms metric stat cards update accordingly.

title: Playwright E2E Test: View Dashboard and Analytics Charts (Must use Playwright)
body:
### Objective
Playwright End-to-End Test verifying dashboard rendering, chart canvas elements, stat cards, and date filtering controls.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Playwright verifies all 4 stat cards render non-zero valid currency values.
- Verifies Recharts SVG chart containers are visible and rendered.
- Tests filter interactions (e.g. category filter, search query).

title: Playwright E2E Test: Trigger AI Category Suggestion (Must use Playwright)
body:
### Objective
Playwright End-to-End Test for the AI-assisted transaction entry workflow.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Open transaction dialog, type merchant name (e.g. 'Uber' or 'Whole Foods').
- Verify AI suggestion pill appears and clicking it auto-fills the category.
- Validate anomaly indicator warning when an exorbitant amount is entered.

title: [Bug] Fix any UI/API bugs discovered during Playwright E2E runs
body:
### Objective
Track, reproduce, and resolve any visual, functional, or timing bugs uncovered during Playwright E2E test runs.

### Bug Protocol
- qa-engineer.md reproduces bugs with failure trace.
- pm.md grooms and prioritizes.
- developer.md implements targeted fixes and verifies with tests.

title: Database Migration: Swap Prisma from SQLite to PostgreSQL
body:
### Objective
Migrate persistence layer from SQLite to PostgreSQL for production readiness, preserving data models and relational constraints.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Prisma schema updated to support PostgreSQL (`provider = "postgresql"`).
- Database connection pooling and environment switching supported.
- Migration scripts verified with PostgreSQL instance.

title: Containerization: Single multi-stage Dockerfile (Static Frontend + Backend)
body:
### Objective
Author optimized production multi-stage Dockerfile packaging Next.js frontend standalone build and Hono server into a minimal alpine/slim container.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Multi-stage build (deps, builder, runner).
- Non-root user execution (`USER node`).
- Image size optimized with standalone output and pruned dependencies.

title: Docker Compose: Create docker-compose.yml (App + PostgreSQL DB)
body:
### Objective
Create complete orchestration configuration in `docker-compose.yml` linking LedgerAI application with a healthy PostgreSQL container.

### Acceptance Criteria
- PostgreSQL service with persistent volume and health check.
- Web app service with environment variables, ports mapped, and `depends_on` condition.
- Single command boot via `docker-compose up -d`.

title: Easy Deploy: Deploy to Render, Vercel, and Railway using Docker Compose ONLY
body:
### Objective
Configure deployment specifications for Render, Vercel, and Railway using Docker Compose exclusively.

### Protocol
- Evaluate platform support for Docker Compose.
- If a platform strictly forbids Compose (e.g. Vercel serverless limitations), document the exact error and limitation in `developer.md` and provide the closest Compose-equivalent fallback configuration (render.yaml, railway.json, vercel.json).

title: Production IaC: GCP Terraform OR AWS CloudFormation (STRICT Free-Tier limits)
body:
### Objective
Provision cloud infrastructure using Terraform (GCP) or CloudFormation (AWS) strictly adhering to Always-Free tier limits with hardcoded anti-billing safeguards.

### Safeguards
- GCP e2-micro instance (US regions: us-central1, us-east1, us-west1) or AWS t4g.nano/t2.micro.
- Free disk allocation (<= 30GB standard persistent disk).
- Anti-scale guardrails: max instances = 1, budget alert trigger at $0.01 spend to shutdown compute.

title: CI/CD Pipeline: GitHub Actions to run Vitest, Playwright E2E, and Integration tests on every commit
body:
### Objective
Construct `.github/workflows/ci-cd.yml` pipeline that triggers on push and pull_request to run linting, unit tests, integration tests, and Playwright E2E suite.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Matrix/caching for node_modules and Playwright browser binaries.
- Run `npm run test` (Vitest) and `npx playwright test`.
- Artifact upload for test reports on failure.

title: CI/CD Pipeline: Auto-deploy to cloud environment on successful commit
body:
### Objective
Extend CI/CD workflow to trigger automated zero-downtime deployment to target cloud environment upon green test pass on main branch.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Deployment step gated by passing test suites.
- Deployment webhook or cloud CLI trigger with secure credential secrets reference.
- Post-deployment health-check probe.

title: Final Documentation: README, Architecture diagram, and Iteration summary
body:
### Objective
Compile comprehensive documentation suite including top-tier README.md, Mermaid system architecture diagram, API reference, and full development lifecycle summary.

### Acceptance Criteria
- High-impact README.md with live screenshots, badges, setup guide, and tech stack breakdown.
- Mermaid architecture diagram illustrating Next.js, Hono, Prisma, and AI heuristics.
- Verification that all 25 issues are verified and closed by QA Engineer.
